title: Printed Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This midi wedding guest dress combines a soft flowing skirt with a flattering bodice for an easy, feminine look. The flutter sleeves bring light movement, while the V-neckline frames the neckline beautifully. A lovely choice for weddings, bridal showers, garden venues, and other special daytime occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
